label: Refined quantonium
note: IP-neutral. Reactor-grade quantonium, refined off the books. The Remnant confiscates it at the gate; the fence pays twice its value, any time, drop or not: carry any contraband to him and [E] opens his stall's menu, not his chat (GearController.talks_first). Not worn (no slot). One of the goods Oda lines up for the smuggling run (board/bar_board.json, j_smuggle_run).
